en: In the middle of or surrounded by something, especially a noisy or difficult situation.
ex: He found calm amid the chaos of the city.
他在城市的混亂中找到了寧靜。

en: An artist who makes figures by carving stone or wood or by shaping clay or metal.
ex: The sculptor spent a year carving the marble statue.
雕塑家花了一年雕刻那座大理石雕像。

en: Made by combining chemicals rather than occurring naturally.
ex: Nylon is a synthetic fiber made from chemicals.
尼龍是一種由化學物質製成的合成纖維。

en: Casual shoes with soft rubber soles, worn for sport or everyday use.
ex: He wore jeans and a pair of white sneakers.
他穿著牛仔褲和一雙白色球鞋。

en: To praise someone or something publicly; or public praise.
ex: The film received critical acclaim around the world.
這部電影獲得全世界評論界的讚譽。

en: To shake or tremble with fear or cold; or an earthquake (short form).
ex: She quaked with fear when she heard the noise.
她聽到聲音時嚇得發抖。

en: The attractive and exciting quality of a person or lifestyle, especially one linked with wealth or fame.
ex: Many young people are attracted by the glamour of show business.
許多年輕人被演藝圈的光鮮所吸引。

en: In a way that is suitable for a particular situation; or as a result of something.
ex: The weather is cold, so dress accordingly.
天氣很冷，所以請穿得適當。

en: Careful about what you say or do so as not to upset or embarrass people.
ex: The detective made some discreet inquiries about the man.
偵探對那名男子做了一些謹慎的查詢。

en: To state something firmly and publicly; or to confirm that something is true.
ex: The court affirmed the earlier decision.
法院確認了先前的判決。

en: A large yellow citrus fruit with a slightly bitter taste.
ex: She has half a grapefruit for breakfast every day.
她每天早餐吃半個葡萄柚。

en: A very poor, crowded area of a city where the housing is of low quality.
ex: Millions of people live in slums with no clean water.
數百萬人住在沒有乾淨水源的貧民窟裡。

en: To improve the quality, value or strength of something.
ex: The new software enhances the speed of the computer.
新軟體提升了電腦的速度。

en: Relating to war or the armed forces; or showing readiness to fight.
ex: He has practiced martial arts since he was a child.
他從小就練習武術。

en: A climbing plant with dark green leaves that often grows on walls.
ex: The old house was covered with ivy.
那棟老房子爬滿了常春藤。

en: To take away an amount from a total; or to remove something from an amount of money.
ex: The company deducts tax from your salary every month.
公司每個月從你的薪水中扣除稅款。

en: A system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance or status.
ex: Employees at the bottom of the hierarchy have little say.
處於階層底端的員工幾乎沒有發言權。

en: Very strict and thorough; or very severe and harsh.
ex: All products go through rigorous safety tests.
所有產品都要通過嚴格的安全測試。

en: A serious medical condition in which the body cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood.
ex: He has to take insulin because of his diabetes.
他因為糖尿病必須注射胰島素。

en: A person whose job is to carry bags at a hotel or station; or a person who guards a door; or a dark beer.
ex: The porter carried our suitcases up to the room.
行李員把我們的行李箱搬到房間。

en: Having a pleasant, sweet smell.
ex: The garden was full of fragrant roses.
花園裡滿是芬芳的玫瑰。

en: To die or to make someone die because they cannot breathe; or to feel uncomfortable because it is too hot or crowded.
ex: Many people almost suffocated in the smoke-filled building.
許多人在充滿濃煙的大樓裡幾乎窒息。

en: The quality of being impressive and powerful; or a title used when talking to or about a king or queen.
ex: We were overwhelmed by the majesty of the mountains.
群山的雄偉讓我們深受震撼。

en: A person trained to prepare and give out medicines in a pharmacy.
ex: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
藥師解釋了這種藥的服用方法。

en: A small breed of horse; or (British slang) twenty-five pounds.
ex: The children took turns riding the pony.
孩子們輪流騎那匹小馬。

en: A narrow area of water connecting two larger seas; or a difficult situation.
ex: Ships must pass through the narrow strait.
船隻必須通過這個狹窄的海峽。

en: Something that happens; or the fact of something happening.
ex: Power cuts are a common occurrence in this area.
停電在這個地區是常見的事。

en: Extremely large; or very shocking or evil.
ex: It was a monstrous crime that shocked the entire nation.
這是一樁震驚全國的滔天罪行。

en: To take something important away from someone, preventing them from having it.
ex: Prisoners were deprived of their basic rights.
囚犯被剝奪了基本權利。

en: The level of confidence, enthusiasm and hope among a group of people.
ex: The victory boosted the morale of the whole team.
這場勝利提振了全隊的士氣。

en: A strong disagreement with an official opinion or decision; or to disagree with it.
ex: There was little dissent among the committee members.
委員會成員之間幾乎沒有異議。

en: A member of the lower house of the US Congress, or of any congress.
ex: The congressman gave a speech about the new budget.
那位國會議員發表了關於新預算的演說。

en: The practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean to prevent disease.
ex: Washing your hands is an important part of good hygiene.
洗手是良好衛生的重要部分。

en: Done too quickly without thinking about the possible results; or a mass of small red spots on the skin.
ex: It would be rash to make a decision without all the facts.
在不了解全部事實的情況下做決定是草率的。

en: A thief who steals things from people's pockets or bags in crowded places.
ex: Beware of pickpockets in the crowded market.
在擁擠的市場裡要小心扒手。

en: To give a religious talk in church; or to give advice about moral behavior, often in an annoying way.
ex: He preaches the importance of honesty to his students.
他向學生宣揚誠實的重要性。

en: An uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch; or a strong desire to do something.
ex: The mosquito bites itch terribly.
蚊子叮咬的地方癢得要命。

en: A movement downward; or a person's family origin.
ex: The plane began its descent into the airport.
飛機開始朝機場下降。

en: To give out something to people, such as medicine or advice; or to do without something.
ex: The pharmacy dispenses medicine to patients.
藥房向病人配發藥品。

en: Not speaking or making any sound; or to make a sound quieter, or turn off sound on a device.
ex: She pressed the mute button during the commercial.
廣告期間她按下了靜音鍵。
